summary: Most core requirements for role separation, admin route guarding, pending-users dashboard, per-role UI visibility, admin actions, login rejection/blocked messaging, and Firestore role typing appear implemented. The main gap is that Firestore rules for helper_admin updates are broader than requested (they only block role/phone/email edits, but still allow other fields). There are also several changes that look out-of-scope/unrequested (e.g., HomeScreen and /home redirect references, major styling/config/doc updates).

missing_requirements.requirement: Update Firestore security rules to allow helper_admin to update only the minimal fields needed to approve/reject (and never role/phone/email).
missing_requirements.reason: The rules only prevent helper_admin from updating role/phone/email, but do not restrict helper_admin updates strictly to approval/rejection fields; as written, helper_admin could update other fields (e.g., name/age/relation/photoURL/blocked/rejected) as long as role/phone/email are untouched.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a HomeScreen and related smoke-test expectations about redirecting approved users to /home.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires approved users continue to redirect to `/chat` on login and explicitly says not to expand the chat system beyond ensuring that behavior. Adding a HomeScreen and documenting /home redirects is not requested and conflicts with the stated constraint (even if code still redirects to /chat).

hallucinated_features.description: Large UI/theming/configuration changes (global CSS OKLCH palette, Tailwind config changes).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; BuildRequest focuses on admin approval dashboard, role separation, login gating, and rules changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Password reset screen reworked into a UI-only manual reset flow messaging (no Firebase reset API calls).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of the requested requirements; BuildRequest does not ask to change/reset password functionality.

hallucinated_features.description: Deployment and smoke-test documentation expanded/added beyond the requested feature implementation.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request new deployment runbooks/smoke test documents as part of the feature delivery.

hallucinated_features.description: Removed/changed authentication provider setup in main entry point (Internet Identity provider removed).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest constraints specify staying within existing React+Firebase frontend and not changing signup flow; removing unrelated auth providers appears out of scope.
